verdict.rationale: Penpot's pricing page lists unlimited teams and no file limits (bounded by storage capacity), and a community user confirms you can use the free hosted instance. Other users say they have replaced Figma with it, and prototyping and components are documented. However, the evidence never explicitly ties these entitlements to a no-cost seat, and several hands-on reports describe lag and crashes on complex files, which weakens the 'usable for real work' claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of what the free plan includes (seats, storage cap, collaboration features), first-party confirmation that collaboration needs no paid seat, and consistent evidence that the editor performs well on complex real-world files.

support.subject: As a designer, the free tier supports real design work — usable editor and collaboration without a paid seat

citations.quote: No file limits. Create as many as you need within your storage capacity. ... Unlimited Teams. Collaborate freely with unlimited teams.
You can self-deploy or use their free instance.
